Name: Luny's Plushies for AT (Bittersweet Haven plushies)
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]﻿


     This is a small mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to change the Futan Bear into Catbats, Catfish, and Ratbats. These critters are my own designs that I made years ago for my shop, and I still absolutely love them! (´꒳`)♡ My room irl has so many of these plushies scattered around, so I'm happy to have them scattered around my Stardew house as well now!

     If you're curious what they're based on, check out my website at [url=https://bittersweethaven.com/]bittersweethaven.com[/url]. If there are any other critters there that you'd like added as AT plushies, let me know and I might add it in an update! (>ᴗ•)



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]﻿

To install:
Download and unzip the file.
Move the folder "[AT] Luny's Plushies" into your StardewValley/mods folder.
You can now use the Paint Bucket from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ to change the Futan Bear into new plushies!
